messages:
katie: FYI ACME reporting intermittent 503s + auth token failures on their Dedicated EU cluster (ded-eu-west-2). Latency spikes ~8-12s. Customer provided request id req-acme-9f2b. Can SRE collect a full debug bundle + node-level GPU logs? Tenant: tenant-acme-42, cluster: ded-eu-west-2, potentially affected pods model-server-0/1.

katie: Sample customer curl (redacted token):
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'x-request-id: req-acme-9f2b' 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate' -d @payload.json
```

dan: Thanks. Can you paste full request-id(s) + time window? We'll need pod names or selectors and the node names to grab node dumps.

katie: Request IDs: req-acme-9f2b, req-acme-9f5c — timestamps 2025-11-03T14:18:26Z -> 2025-11-03T14:24:10Z. Pod selector: namespace tenant-acme label app=model-server.

mira: Oncall here — I can take the collection. Need output of: `kubectl get pods -n tenant-acme -l app=model-server -o wide` so I can target pods and nodes.

katie: kubectl output (from console):
model-server-0   1/1 Running   3h   node=ded-eu-node-34
model-server-1   1/1 Running   2h   node=ded-eu-node-35

leo: I'll ssh node ded-eu-node-34 and collect:
- sudo journalctl -u kubelet -S '2025-11-03 14:00:00' > /tmp/kubelet.log
- sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg.log
- nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,UTILIZATION > /tmp/nvidia.txt
- cp /var/log/messages /tmp/messages.log
Also grab pod cgroup stats and sar output.

mira: On the pod side I'll run: `kubectl logs -n tenant-acme model-server-0 --since=1h > /tmp/modelserver0.log` and `kubectl exec -n tenant-acme model-server-0 -- cat /proc/$(pgrep model_server)/environ > /tmp/env.txt`

dan: We'll also need telemetry traces for those request-ids. Pinging telemetry team to extract distributed traces for req-acme-9f2b and req-acme-9f5c.

katie: Please ask customer to repro with explicit x-request-id and include -i to capture headers. Suggested repro curl to send them:
```
curl -X POST 'https://ded-eu-west-2.internal.redwood/v1/generate' \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n -H 'x-request-id: req-acme-9f2b' \n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n -d '{"input":"test latency"}' -i
```

support-bot: Diag bundle job created: bundle-id 20251103-1758102468-acme. Upload URL: s3://redwood-support/ci/20251103/1758102468-acme-bundle.tar.gz (expires in 7 days).

mira: Started collection now. ETA ~12m. Will run pod logs, exec env dump, and node dmesg/nvidia-smi. If we see GPU Xid errors escalate to eng-runtime.

leo: :thumbsup: queued node snapshot. Commands I'm running remotely: `sar -u -r 1 60`, `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv`, and full /proc/mounts checks.

dan: Quick question — did we see any unusual billing or batching spikes for tenant-acme around the window? That could cause larger-than-normal vram usage.

katie: Yes, customer had a burst of long generations and embeddings during that window; billing shows increased token usage and longer outputs. I'll include a billing snapshot in the bundle.

mira: Bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-support/ci/20251103/1758102468-acme-bundle.tar.gz. Quick findings (preliminary): model-server-0 logs show repeated 500s with message "CUDA launch failed: out of memory" around 14:19-14:23Z. dmesg contains GPU Xid 13 errors. nvml snapshot: GPU memory ~92% at peak.

mira: Commands I ran (for reference):
- `grep 'CUDA launch failed' /tmp/modelserver0.log | head -n 20`
- `tail -n 200 /tmp/dmesg.log | grep -i xid`
- `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv > /tmp/nvml.csv`

leo: Next steps recommended: roll a canary model variant with lower batch size for tenant-acme and route a portion of traffic to model-server-1 which had slightly lower GPU utilization. Also schedule an infra autoscaler tweak to prevent OOMs during load bursts. I'll open ticket INF-589 and reference the bundle.

dan: Creating support incident INC-ACME-20251103 linking to the diag bundle and INF-589. Notifying account + CS.

katie: Notified customer and suggested they temporarily reduce concurrency and retry. We'll update them after INF-589 progress.

mira: Marking thread: collection complete, preliminary cause GPU memory exhaustion under bursty load. Escalating to eng-runtime for fix and longer-term mitigations.

katie: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with customer once infra ticket has ETA. :thumbsup:
